title: Isaiah 9: For Unto Us a Child Is Born
body:
Read the chapter → [Isaiah 9](/bible/isaiah/9)

**[Isaiah 9:1](/bible/isaiah/9#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/isaiah/9#v1)</sup> Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

- The dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, and afterward more grievously afflicted her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
  - **[Matthew 4:15](/bible/matthew/4#v15)**
    > <sup>[15](/bible/matthew/4#v15)</sup> The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

    This is the prophecy of Galilee of the Gentiles, the land of Zebulun and Naphtali by the sea.

**[Isaiah 9:2-4](/bible/isaiah/9#v2)**

> <sup>[2](/bible/isaiah/9#v2)</sup> The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/isaiah/9#v3)</sup> Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/isaiah/9#v4)</sup> For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

- "The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined."
- The Most High multiplied the nation and increased the joy; they joy before him according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil, for he has broken the yoke of his burden, the staff of his shoulder, and the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

**[Isaiah 9:5](/bible/isaiah/9#v5)**

> <sup>[5](/bible/isaiah/9#v5)</sup> For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

- "For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire."
- The confused noise is swords clashing, guns firing, and people hollering, with garments rolled in blood; but this final battle is with burning and fuel of fire, a prophecy of the nuclear bomb.

**[Isaiah 9:6-7](/bible/isaiah/9#v6)**

> <sup>[6](/bible/isaiah/9#v6)</sup> For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/isaiah/9#v7)</sup> Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.

- "For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace."
- Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David and upon his kingdom, to order and establish it with judgment and justice for ever; the zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.

**[Isaiah 9:8-10](/bible/isaiah/9#v8)**

> <sup>[8](/bible/isaiah/9#v8)</sup> The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/isaiah/9#v9)</sup> And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/isaiah/9#v10)</sup> The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

- The Most High sent a word into Jacob, and it lighted upon Israel, so that all the people, even Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, shall know it.
- In pride and stoutness of heart they say, "The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars."

**[Isaiah 9:11-12](/bible/isaiah/9#v11)**

> <sup>[11](/bible/isaiah/9#v11)</sup> Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/isaiah/9#v12)</sup> The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

- Therefore the Most High shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him and join his enemies together, the Syrians before and the Philistines behind, and they shall devour Israel with open mouth.
- For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

**[Isaiah 9:13](/bible/isaiah/9#v13)**

> <sup>[13](/bible/isaiah/9#v13)</sup> For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.

- The people turn not to him that smites them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.
  - **[Hosea 5:15](/bible/hosea/5#v15)**
    > <sup>[15](/bible/hosea/5#v15)</sup> I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

    The Most High returns to his place until, in their affliction, the people seek him early.

**[Isaiah 9:14-17](/bible/isaiah/9#v14)**

> <sup>[14](/bible/isaiah/9#v14)</sup> Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/isaiah/9#v15)</sup> The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/isaiah/9#v16)</sup> For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/isaiah/9#v17)</sup> Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

- The Most High will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day; the ancient and honourable is the head, and the prophet that teaches lies is the tail.
- The leaders of this people cause them to err, and they that are led of them are destroyed; therefore the Most High will have no joy in their young men, nor mercy on their fatherless and widows, for everyone is a hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly.
- For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

**[Isaiah 9:18-21](/bible/isaiah/9#v18)**

> <sup>[18](/bible/isaiah/9#v18)</sup> For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/isaiah/9#v19)</sup> Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/isaiah/9#v20)</sup> And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/isaiah/9#v21)</sup> Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

- Wickedness burns as the fire, devouring briers and thorns and kindling in the thickets of the forest, mounting up like the lifting of smoke; through the wrath of the Lord of hosts the land is darkened and the people are as the fuel of the fire.
- No man shall spare his brother; he shall snatch on the right hand and be hungry, and eat on the left hand and not be satisfied, every man eating the flesh of his own arm.
- Manasseh shall be against Ephraim, and Ephraim against Manasseh, and together they shall be against Judah; for all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
